meta.name: Swiss Index
meta.notes: Primary fills large solid blocks only (12-segment hero bar, row-hover fills, CTA band, buttons with on-primary text), so pastels, navies and near-blacks all stay legible; images get a primary duotone; accent is only used for small tag markers.

issues: Scroll reveals broke the page: CSS scroll-behavior:smooth made fast or programmatic scrolling skip the IntersectionObserver, so from section 03 down the giant section numerals, USP list, story and stats stayed invisible. That left huge empty voids, and the whole of section 02 was blank on the stress brand
Mobile product index broken: the later `.g` 4-column rule overrode the `.ix-a` row template, so product names got squeezed into a quarter-width column and cut off ('Droogijss…')
Desktop index rows only light up on hover; the number column is tiny and gets lost, with no big typographic moment inside the row
Reveal caption shows only the number and tag, and never the price, which is a core column of the INDEX
Hero plate is a small 3-column thumbnail lost in the bottom-right corner with no frame
Mobile header nav is clipped hard at the edge ('Contai') with no hint that it scrolls
fixed: Removed CSS smooth scrolling and moved smooth scrolling for in-page anchors to JS. Added a scroll-pass check so any element at or above the viewport bottom is always revealed. Every numeral and section now renders
Raised the mobile row template's specificity (`.ix-a.g`) so it beats the 4-column grid: thumbnail / full-width name / price layout restored
Signature push: a giant outlined grotesk numeral (01, 02…) rises inside the primary-colour fill of the hovered index row, clipped to the row, next to the cursor image reveal
The cursor reveal caption now reads number — tag — price
Hero plate widened to 4 columns at 3:2 with a hairline frame; CTAs top-aligned in their 4 columns
Mobile/tablet nav gets a right-edge fade mask to signal that it scrolls
